description: This file defines the ChatController class, which manages the chat session including message handling, session management, event processing, and communication with a backend service in a Kotlin-based Android application.

classes.name: ChatController
classes.description: Main class responsible for managing chat sessions, handling messages, events, and interactions with the backend GatewaySession.

classes.name: MainSessionState
classes.description: Data class representing the current and applied main session key states.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a chat session by session key and initializes the bootstrap process.

methods.name: applyMainSessionKey
methods.description: Sets and applies the main session key.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Triggers a bootstrap to refresh session data and health status.

methods.name: refreshSessions
methods.description: Fetches the list of available sessions, with an optional limit.

methods.name: setThinkingLevel
methods.description: Sets and normalizes the thinking level state.

methods.name: switchSession
methods.description: Switches to a different session by session key and refreshes data accordingly.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message with optional attachments and thinking level in a coroutine.

methods.name: sendMessageAwaitAcceptance
methods.description: Handles the actual message sending process, including updating UI states and backend communication, returning success status.

methods.name: abort
methods.description: Aborts ongoing chat runs by their run IDs, sending abort requests to the backend.

methods.name: handleGatewayEvent
methods.description: Processes incoming real-time gateway events such as chat messages, agent events, health, and sequence gaps.

methods.name: bootstrap
methods.description: Initializes or refreshes the chat session, including history, health, and session list.

methods.name: fetchSessions
methods.description: Fetches the session list from the backend.

methods.name: pollHealthIfNeeded
methods.description: Polls the health status from backend if enough time has passed or forced.

methods.name: handleChatEvent
methods.description: Processes chat-related events, updating message state and handling terminal or delta states.

methods.name: handleAgentEvent
methods.description: Handles agent stream events, including assistant text and tool call phases.

methods.name: parseAssistantDeltaText
methods.description: Extracts assistant delta streaming text content from payload.

methods.name: publishPendingToolCalls
methods.description: Updates the observable list of pending tool calls.

methods.name: armPendingRunTimeout
methods.description: Sets a timeout for a pending run ID, removing it if timed out.

methods.name: clearPendingRun
methods.description: Clears a specific pending run ID and cancels its timeout.

methods.name: clearPendingRuns
methods.description: Clears all pending runs and associated timeouts.

methods.name: parseHistory
methods.description: Parses message history JSON into message objects, reconciling message IDs.

methods.name: parseMessageContent
methods.description: Parses individual message content entries from JSON elements.

methods.name: parseSessions
methods.description: Parses sessions list JSON into session entries.

methods.name: parseRunId
methods.description: Extracts run ID from response JSON.

methods.name: normalizeThinking
methods.description: Normalizes raw thinking level strings to predefined categories.
